rationale: 15 independent recordings make whole-session holdout possible for the first time. Every number before this was a best-of-N-epochs minimum on the frames used to pick the checkpoint - no generalisation estimate existed anywhere in the ladder. Deviates from KB Decision 35's within-session contiguous holdout; needs its own dated entry. The guard band is no longer required: sessions are independent recordings, not adjacent frames of one drift.
selection_rule: test/val chosen by POSITION in the sorted session_id list - the last two and the two before - fixed before any metric was computed, so the held-out set cannot be picked to flatter a result.
